52: //------------------------------------------------------------------------------
53: class log_writer : private ser::importer
54: {
55: public:
56:     //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
57:     log_writer()
58:     {
59:         m_timestamp_base = 0;
60:         m_fmt            = nullptr;
61:         m_fmt_modif      = 0;
62:         prints_severity  = prints_timestamp = true;
63:         m_sync           = nullptr;
64:     }
65:     //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
66:     void set_synchronizer (async_to_sync& sync)
67:     {
68:         m_sync = &sync;
69:     }
70:     //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
71:     void set_timestamp_base (u64 base)
72:     {
73:         m_timestamp_base = base;
74:     }
75:     //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
76:     bool decode_and_write (output& o, const u8* msg)
77:     {
78:         assert (msg);
79: 
80:         init (msg);
81: 
82:         ser::header_data h;
83:         do_import (h);
84: 
85:         if (h.sync != nullptr) { m_sync->notify (*h.sync); }
86: 
87:         set_next_msg_fmt_string (h.fmt);
88:         o.entry_begin (h.severity);
89: 
90:         if (prints_timestamp) {
91:             write_timestamp(
92:                 o,
93:                 h.has_tstamp ?
94:                     h.tstamp : (get_ns_timestamp() - m_timestamp_base)
95:                 );
96:         }
97:         if (prints_severity) { write_severity (o, h.severity); }
98: 
99:         uword params   = h.arity;
100:         bool fmt_param = find_param_in_fmt_str (o, params > 0);
101: 
102:         while (params > 0 && fmt_param) {
103:             consume_next (o, true);
104:             --params;
105:             fmt_param = find_param_in_fmt_str (o, params > 0);
106:         }
107: 
108: #ifdef MAL_COMPILE_TIME_FMT_CHECK
109:         assert (params == 0 && !fmt_param);
110: #else
111:         if (params) {
112:             do {
113:                 consume_next (o, false);
114:                 --params;
115:             }
116:             while (params);
117:             static const char excess_params[] =
118:                 "\n[logger err]->too many parameters in previous log entry. "
119:                  "fmt string was: ";
120:             o.write (excess_params, sizeof excess_params - 1);
121:             o.write (h.fmt);
122:             assert (false && "too many parameters, see log output for details");
123:         }
124:         if (fmt_param) {
125:             do {
126:                 fmt_param = find_param_in_fmt_str (o, params > 0);
127:             }
128:             while (fmt_param);
129:             static const char excess_placeholders[] =
130:                 "\n[logger err]->too many placeholders in previous log entry. "
131:                   "fmt string was: ";
132:             o.write (excess_placeholders, sizeof excess_placeholders - 1);
133:             o.write (h.fmt);
134:             assert(
135:                 false && "too many placeholders, see log output for details"
136:                 );
137:         }
138: #endif
139:         o.entry_end();
140:         if (h.severity >= sev::critical) {
141:             o.flush();
142:         }
143:         return true;
144:     }
145:     //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
146:     bool prints_severity;
147:     //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
148:     bool prints_timestamp;
149:     //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
150: private:
151:     //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
152:     void consume_next (output& o, bool has_placeholder)
153:     {
154:         using namespace ser;
155:         ser::decoding_field d;
156:         import_type (d);
157:         if (d.gen.fclass == mal_numeric) {
158:             if (d.gen.nclass == mal_integral) {
159:                 output_integral (o, d.num_int, has_placeholder);
160:             }
161:             else {
162:                 assert (d.gen.nclass == mal_non_integral);
163:                 output_non_integral (o, d.nom_no_int, has_placeholder);
164:             }
165:         }
166:         else {
167:             assert (d.gen.fclass == mal_non_numeric);
168:             output_non_numeric (o, d.no_num, has_placeholder);
169:         }
170:     }
171:     //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
172:     void output_integral(
173:             output& o, ser::integral_field f, bool has_placeholder
174:             )
175:     {
176:         using namespace ser;
177:         uword type = f.original_type;
178:         type      += ((uword) f.is_negative) * 4;
179: 
180:         switch (type) {
181:         case 0: return output_char<u8_modif> (o, f, has_placeholder);
182:         case 1: return output_int_type<u16, u16_modif> (o, f, has_placeholder);
183:         case 2: return output_int_type<u32, u32_modif> (o, f, has_placeholder);
184:         case 3: return output_int_type<u64, u64_modif> (o, f, has_placeholder);
185:         case 4: return output_char<i8_modif> (o, f, has_placeholder);
186:         case 5: return output_int_type<i16, i16_modif> (o, f, has_placeholder);
187:         case 6: return output_int_type<i32, i32_modif> (o, f, has_placeholder);
188:         case 7: return output_int_type<i64, i64_modif> (o, f, has_placeholder);
189:         default: return;
190:         }
191:     }
192:     //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
193:     void output_non_integral(
194:             output& o, ser::non_integral_field f, bool has_placeholder
195:             )
196:     {
197:         using namespace ser;
198:         switch (f.niclass) {
199:         case mal_double:
200:             return output_floating_type<double, u64, double_modif>(
201:                     o, f, has_placeholder
202:                     );
203:         case mal_float :
204:             return output_floating_type<float, u32, float_modif>(
205:                                             o, f, has_placeholder
206:                                             );
207:         case mal_bool: {
208:             if (!has_placeholder) { return; }
209: 
210:             static const char true_val[]  = "true";
211:             static const char false_val[] = "false";
212:             if (f.bool_val != 0) { o.write (true_val, sizeof true_val - 1); }
213:             else                 { o.write (false_val, sizeof false_val - 1); }
214:             break;
215:         }
216:         default:
217:             assert (false && "bug");
218:             break;
219:         }
220:     }
221:     //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
222:     void output_non_numeric(
223:             output& o, ser::non_numeric_field f, bool has_placeholder
224:             )
225:     {
226:         using namespace ser;
227:         switch (f.nnclass) {
228:         case mal_c_str: {
229:             literal_wrapper l;
230:             do_import (l, f);
231:             if (has_placeholder && l.lit) {
232:                 o.write (l.lit);
233:             }
234:             else if (!l.lit) {
235:                 static const char lit_null_err[] =
236:                     "([logger err]->nullptr literal, ignored)";
237:                 o.write (lit_null_err, sizeof lit_null_err - 1);
238:                 assert (false && "null literal");
239:             }
240:             break;
241:         }
242:         case mal_ptr: {
243:             static_assert (sizeof (uword) == 4 || sizeof (uword) == 8, "");
244:             const char* fmt = (sizeof (uword) == 4) ?
245:                                     u32_modif::hex : u64_modif::hex;
246:             ptr_wrapper p;
247:             do_import (p, f);
248:             uword v = (uword) p.ptr;
249: 
250:             if (has_placeholder) {
251:                 output_num (o, v, fmt);
252:             }
253:             break;
254:         }
255:         case mal_deep_copied_str : {
256:             deep_copy_string str;
257:             do_import (str, f);
258:             if (has_placeholder) {
259:                 o.write (str.mem, str.size);
260:             }

89: class queue_prepared
90: {
91: public:
92:     enum error {
93:         success,
94:         queue_full,
95:         entry_size,
96:         queue_blocked,
97:         count,
98:     };
99:     queue_prepared()
100:     {
101:         mem = nullptr;
102:         pos = 0;
103:     }
104:     u8* get_mem() const
105:     {
106:         return ((uword) mem >= count) ? mem : nullptr;
107:     }
108:     error get_error() const
109:     {
110:         return (((uword) mem) < count) ? *((error*) &mem) : success;
111:     }
112:     size_t transaction_value()
113:     {
114:         return pos;
115:     }
116: private:
117:     friend class queue;
118:     void set_error (error e, size_t pos)
119:     {
120:         *((error*) &mem) = e;
121:     }
122:     void set (u8* mem, size_t pos)
123:     {
124:         this->mem = mem;
125:         this->pos = pos;
126:     }
127:     u8*    mem;
128:     size_t pos;
129: };
130: //------------------------------------------------------------------------------
131: // Roughly explained this is the Dmytry MPMC queue converted to MPSC, and broken
132: // into prepare/commit blocks that allow the use of a parallel heap based queue
133: // to be optionally used when the main fixed sized queue can't allocate entries
134: // (either because the queue is full or because a given entry exceeds the fixed
135: // entry size).
136: //
137: // The queue is still linearizable.
138: //------------------------------------------------------------------------------
139: class queue
140: {
141: private:
142:     //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
143:     struct heap_node : public mpsc_node_hook
144:     {
145:         //----------------------------------------------------------------------
146:         u8* storage()
147:         {
148:             return ((u8*) this) + sizeof *this;
149:         }
150:         //----------------------------------------------------------------------
151:         static heap_node* from_storage (u8* mem)
152:         {
153:             return (heap_node*) (mem - sizeof (heap_node));
154:         }
155:         //----------------------------------------------------------------------
156:         static uword strict_total_size (uword effective_size)
157:         {
158:             return sizeof (heap_node) + effective_size;
159:         }
160:         //----------------------------------------------------------------------
161:         static uword effective_size (uword total_size)
162:         {
163:             auto v = total_size - sizeof (heap_node);
164:             assert (v < total_size);
165:             return v;
166:         }
167:         //----------------------------------------------------------------------
168:         size_t pos;
169:     };
170:     //--------------------------------------------------------------------------
171:     struct local_cell
172:     {
173:         at::atomic<size_t> sequence;
174:         //----------------------------------------------------------------------
175:         u8* storage()
176:         {
177:             return ((u8*) this) + sizeof *this;
178:         }
179:         //----------------------------------------------------------------------
180:         static local_cell* from_storage (u8* p)
181:         {
182:             return (local_cell*) (p - sizeof (local_cell));
183:         }
184:         //----------------------------------------------------------------------
185:         static uword strict_total_size (uword effective_size)
186:         {
187:             return sizeof (local_cell) + effective_size;
188:         }
189:         //----------------------------------------------------------------------
190:         static uword effective_size (uword total_size)
191:         {
192:             auto v = total_size - sizeof (local_cell);
193:             assert (v < total_size);
194:             return v;
195:         }
196:         //----------------------------------------------------------------------
197:     };

201:         bounded,
